a.title: contracts: tool policy, setModel, briefTurnId, session.started endpoint
a.body: Provider-contract follow-up from the Agent SDK spike and the adapter: SessionSpec.toolPolicy with first-match rules, Provider.setModel plus a capabilities flag, SessionHandle.briefTurnId, and a session.started endpoint. Includes a conformance check that briefTurnId is a TurnId.

b.title: conformance: a handle's briefTurnId must be a TurnId
b.body: A provider that emits nothing until something is pushed at it has a turn running before any observer attaches, so briefTurnId must be a real TurnId the first turn.started can refer to. This adds that check to resumeChecks() and a test that a handle naming anything else is caught.

source: v1: #35 duplicating #34 in this repo. Both are the briefTurnId conformance check the same spike produced, and #34's branch already carried it - building both is the duplicate effort §5.2's dedupe rule exists to stop.
